# Epistemics Regulations Due to the nature of the Epistemics Department’s work, there is a high likelihood of unexpected and highly dangerous anomalous events. To ameliorate this risk, research should be conducted according to the following regulations.
[textlink="Artifacts" link="Artifacts"] governs the proper handling and research of ancient alien artifacts.
[textlink="Anomalies" link="Anomalies"] governs procedure on safe handling and containment of anomalies, including infectious anomalies and anomalous entities.
[textlink="Glimmer" link="Glimmer"] regulates maintenance of the Noosphere, including the duties of mantis and chaplain.
